title: Japanese-style resource packs
description: This is a resource pack that gives the Minecraft world a Japanese-style look.
body:
# 和風³ — Japanese Architecture Resource Pack

> **Minecraft 1.20.5 – 1.21.4** | pack_format 32–46 | 68 textures

A resource pack built for authentic Japanese-style Minecraft builds.  
Covers everything from **dark charcoal roof tiles** and **vermilion pillars** to **shoji paper windows** and **andon lanterns** — all tuned to match real wafū architecture references.

Mix and match block choices to switch between three distinct roof styles without swapping packs.

---

## ✨ Features

### 🏯 Three Roof Tile Styles
| Style | Color | Blocks |
|---|---|---|
| Classic 瓦 (charcoal) | Deep charcoal-gray | Blackstone, Polished Blackstone, Deepslate Tiles |
| Palace 宮殿 (teal) | Deep teal-green | Warped Planks, Prismarine Bricks |
| Shrine 寺社 (orange) | Warm orange | Terracotta, Orange/Red Terracotta |

### 🌲 Four Wood Tones
- **Dark Oak** — Deep burnt brown for pillars and beams
- **Crimson** — Vermilion red (神社 shrine / palace style)
- **Spruce / Oak** — Warm medium brown for walls
- **Cherry** — Soft sakura-pink wood

### 🪟 Shoji Glass
Glass and glass panes become washi paper with a wooden grid overlay. Semi-transparent with a subtle handmade paper texture.

### 🏮 Andon Lanterns
Glowstone and Shroomlight glow with a warm amber lantern look instead of the default harsh yellow.

### 🎋 More Details
- Bamboo blocks with visible nodes and cross-section tops
- Cherry / Oak leaves with pink sakura blossoms mixed in
- Sand recolored as a zen garden raked pattern (枯山水)
- Red / Crimson wool → noren curtain texture (暖簾)
- Purpur Block → polished purple stone courtyard floor

## 🔧 Installation

1. Download the `.zip` file
2. Drop it into `.minecraft/resourcepacks/` — **do not extract**
3. Launch Minecraft → **Options → Resource Packs** → activate

### For server-wide auto-apply
Add to `server.properties`:
```
resource-pack=https://your-zip-url-here
resource-pack-required=false
```
